name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for hillside deck construction?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for hillside deck construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, gather any existing property surveys, understand your general design preferences, and set a realistic budget. Having a clear idea of your desired deck size, location on the hill, and intended use (e.g., entertaining, relaxation) will help contractors provide more accurate initial estimates. Be prepared to discuss challenges like site access and view preservation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting a contractor, prepare property surveys, define design preferences, and establish a budget for your hillside deck project.
